title: Addition polymers
caption: Many alkene molecules join by opening their C=C bonds. Ethene gives poly(ethene), propene gives poly(propene) with a CH₃ on every other carbon, and chloroethene gives PVC with a Cl on every other carbon. Each chain shown is a short section.
alt: Ethene, propene and chloroethene, each above a short section of its polymer chain.
description: Ethene → poly(ethene): a long saturated chain.
Propene → poly(propene): methyl groups on alternate carbons.
Chloroethene → PVC: chlorine atoms on alternate carbons.
